newsitem.title: USA: Rite Aid waiting period ends for Thrifty.
newsitem.headline: Rite Aid waiting period ends for Thrifty.

text.p: Rite Aid Corp said on Thursday that the Federal Trade Commission has ended early the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period for Rite Aid's pending merger with Thrifty PayLess Holdings Inc.
Rite Aid said it has scheduled a special meeting for December 12 for shareholders of record November 12 to vote on the proposed merger.
Thrifty shares rose 1/8 to 22-3/8 Thursday noon. Rite Aid shares were off 1/8 to 35.
Rite Aid, after ending a bid for Revco D.S. Inc, is seeking to buy Thrifty in a deal scheduled to close in early 1997.
The deal was worth more than $1.3 billion when it was announced last month.
